title: Add an opt-in executable-mode check before package publication
body:
A directly launched verifier can run locally but lose its execute bit in the published commit. Raw byte comparison cannot detect this. Add `--check-modes` to the publication preflight to compare POSIX owner-execute bits with Git modes for the package and its declared inputs. The default byte-only check is unchanged.

Use `python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/NAME --check-modes`. The report states when modes were checked. This option requires POSIX and does not validate ACLs, mount policy, Windows launch rules or interpreter availability.

Validation: 15 commit-preflight tests pass, including real Git commits with added and removed execute bits, a CLI failure control and `core.filemode=false`. The 4 new tests pass under `-O`; `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main, priorities, live PR paths and Discussions checked. I omitted a guide edit because PR4102/4103 already edit that guide. No active PR touches the checker. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `ce7e7a27064c5e98b75b6d0c74e4474dca9ad0fe`.
